name: agent-signals
description: Source-cited record of what is changing in AI coding: coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Pi) and coding-relevant models from the main labs, with attributed takes from trusted practitioners.

interface.longDescription: Agent Signals by ZazenCodes tracks what is changing in AI coding. Every update cites an official source (changelogs, release feeds, docs, model pages, vendor announcements) with a verbatim evidence quote. News that a trusted practitioner reports first is labelled as reported until an official source confirms it, and practitioners' posts are attached as attributed commentary. Ask what changed in Codex this week, which coding models dropped this month, what practitioners think of the latest Claude Code release, or for a weekly briefing to share with your team. Every answer shows how fresh the data is.
capabilities: Recent changes to Claude Code, Codex and Pi, with official sources
New coding-relevant models from tracked labs, with open-weights status
Attributed takes from trusted AI-coding practitioners
A weekly briefing formatted for sharing with a team
defaultPrompt: What changed in Codex this week?
What new coding models dropped this month?
Give me this week's signals briefing for my team.

positive.description: Recent changes for one coding agent
positive.prompt: What changed in Codex this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls whats_new with entity codex and a seven-day window, then lists changes with source links and dates, distinguishing practitioner-reported findings from officially sourced changes and mentioning data freshness.

positive.description: New models over a longer window
positive.prompt: What new coding models dropped this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls new_models with since set to the start of the current calendar month, then lists models with publisher, status, open-weights flag and source, distinguishing release dates from detection dates. A last-30-days follow-up uses a rolling thirty-day window.

positive.prompt: What are trusted practitioners saying about the latest Claude Code release?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls whats_new with entity claude-code to find current releases and related findings, then presents linked practitioner takes as attributed opinions with stance and post links, noting when commentary is about nearby releases or the broader product direction rather than the exact latest patch.

positive.prompt: Give me this week's signals briefing for my team.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls weekly_briefing and returns the summary, highlights and notable changes with sources, plus the coverage note, formatted for sharing.

positive.prompt: Catch me up on what Anthropic has shipped for coding in the last month.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls entity_briefing with entity anthropic, then summarizes recorded models and findings from the last 30 days with sources and practitioner take counts.

negative.description: General coding help unrelated to tracking changes
negative.prompt: Write me a Python function that reverses a linked list.
Sign me up for a Claude Max subscription.
What's the latest news on the stock market today?

publication.release_notes: First release: whats_new, entity_briefing, new_models, weekly_briefing and list_tracked, with a timeline widget for recent changes and weekly briefings.
